lines.caption: This week: seagulls! Here's what I've been building.

lines.text: First, the legendary seagull. I set it up in Blueprints so that on the third enemy it hits... it explodes.
Next, meteor seagulls. I made a new particle effect, so every impact leaves a mark on the ground.
Then the shockwave. A curve controls how fast the ring grows, and how it fades out.
Run it in the game, and the ring pushes out right from the capybara.
And it all stacks: multiple seagulls can drop at once! So, what should the next seagull do? Tell me in the comments!
